title: In vitro induction of trained immunity in adherent human monocytes
author: Domínguez-Andrés, Arts, et al.

steps.title: Set up Ficoll density gradient
steps.instruction: Transfer the blood from each buffy coat into eight 50 mL conical tubes, adjust each tube to 35 mL with PBS, then slowly layer 14 mL Ficoll‑Paque beneath the PBS‑blood layer using a 10 mL pipette (final volume 49 mL). Disable the brake on the centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer blood from each buffy coat into eight 50 mL conical tubes.
Add PBS to bring each tube to 35 mL total volume.
Using a 10 mL pipette, slowly add 14 mL Ficoll‑Paque under the PBS‑blood layer (gravity).
Ensure the final tube volume is 49 mL and disable the centrifuge brake.

steps.title: Centrifuge and harvest PBMCs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 615 × g for 30 min at 20 °C with acceleration 1 and no brake; collect the PBMC layer with a sterile Pasteur pipette, transfer cells from each donor into four 50 mL conical tubes, and add PBS to bring the volume to 50 mL (avoid cells attached to the tube wall).

substeps.instruction: Spin at 615 × g for 30 min at 20 °C, acceleration 1, no brake.
Using a sterile Pasteur pipette, carefully collect the PBMC layer.
Pool the collected PBMCs from each donor into four 50 mL conical tubes.
Add PBS to each tube to reach a final volume of 50 mL, omitting any cells that are stuck to the tube wall.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs on ice
steps.instruction: Perform all washes on ice: spin at 550 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and pool pellets into two 50 mL tubes per donor; wash with cold PBS to a final volume of 50 mL, spin at 550 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and pool into one 50 mL tube per donor; repeat the wash (c and d) once more; finally resuspend cells in 30 mL RPMI 1640 without serum and count.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 550 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and pool pellets into two 50 mL conical tubes per donor.
Wash with cold PBS to a total volume of 50 mL.
Spin at 550 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and pool pellets into one 50 mL conical tube per donor.
Repeat the wash (steps c and d) once more.
Resuspend the final pellet in 30 mL RPMI 1640 without serum.
Count cells using a hemocytometer or an automated counter.

steps.title: Prepare hyper‑osmotic Percoll solution
steps.instruction: For 100 mL of solution, mix 48.5 mL Percoll, 41.5 mL sterile water, and 10.0 mL 0.22 µm‑filtered 1.6 M NaCl; vortex vigorously until homogeneous.

substeps.instruction: Measure 48.5 mL Percoll.
Add 41.5 mL sterile water.
Add 10.0 mL 0.22 µm‑filtered 1.6 M NaCl.
Shake/vortex vigorously to mix.

steps.title: Set up Percoll monocyte gradient
steps.instruction: Adjust the isolated PBMC suspension to 50–70 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ in RPMI 1640, add 10 mL hyper‑osmotic Percoll to a 15 mL conical tube, then slowly layer 3 mL of the PBMC suspension on top of the Percoll using a 1 mL pipette (tilt tube, keep tip ~1 cm above the Percoll surface).

substeps.instruction: Dilute PBMCs to 50–70 × 10⁶ cells per mL in RPMI 1640.
Add 10 mL hyper‑osmotic Percoll solution to a 15 mL conical tube.
Using a 1 mL pipette, slowly add 3 mL PBMC suspension on top of the Percoll, tilting the tube and keeping the tip about 1 cm above the Percoll surface.

steps.title: Centrifuge Percoll gradient
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the gradient at 580 × g for 15 min at 20 °C with acceleration 1 and no brake.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 580 × g for 15 min at 20 °C, acceleration 1, no brake.

steps.title: Collect monocyte interphase
steps.instruction: Using a sterile Pasteur pipette, collect the interphase layer while avoiding the last 4 mL at the bottom; combine material from up to three tubes, add cold PBS to a final volume of 50 mL.

substeps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the interphase layer with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Do not collect the bottom 4 mL of the tube.
Combine the collected material from up to three tubes.
Add cold PBS to bring the total volume to 50 mL.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend monocytes
steps.instruction: Spin the combined fraction at 350 × g for 7 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 3 mL RPMI 1640 (monocyte‑enriched suspension), count cells, and optionally assess purity by flow cytometry (CD45⁺ CD14⁺, expected 40–80 %).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 350 × g for 7 min at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL RPMI 1640 (monocyte‑enriched suspension).
Count cells using a hemocytometer or automated counter.
Optional: determine cell purity by flow cytometry (CD45⁺ CD14⁺, 40–80 % expected).

steps.title: Perform paired non‑parametric analysis
steps.instruction: For each donor, compare cytokine production after restimulation of trained versus non‑trained cells using a paired, non‑parametric test; apply the Wilcoxon signed‑rank test to evaluate whether the cytokine levels differ.
